items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Theorem 7.4.12 at source lines 984-989, with the author's complete 73-line proof at source lines 990-1062. The proof is not a formal consequence of the statement: it builds a two-by-two diagram of cocone types (source lines 994-1003), applies the two-out-of-three property for equivalences twice (lines 1005-1006 and 1037), and the middle horizontal arrow is an equivalence only because both lower vertical arrows are happly and hence equivalences by function extensionality (lines 1017-1023). The remaining content is the lower square: the coherence path q of the lowest arrow has to be assembled from the naturality homotopies nat^f_n and nat^g_n (lines 1027-1035), and the composite obtained that way must then be compared component by component through happly with the composite coming from transport along the cocone (lines 1042-1058). A statement that truncation preserves pushouts gives no hint that this alignment of transport, function extensionality and cocone functoriality is what has to be checked.
